note: Structural Condition Ledger for the Cumulative Erosion Sub-Index. Human-reviewed; entries proposed by AI research passes on 2026-07-28 and vetted/merged by the maintainer the same day. See docs/cumulative-erosion-subindex-proposal.md for the magnitude rubric and update process.

entries.title: IEEPA national-emergency declarations used to impose sweeping tariffs without Congress
entries.note: Emergency powers run routine trade policy Apr 2025 - Feb 2026; SCOTUS reversed in Learning Resources v. Trump (2026-02-20): IEEPA does not authorize tariffs. Kept as reversed for the historical record; contributes 0 after reversal date. Judicial check functioned here.

entries.title: Pocket rescission executed: appropriated funds withheld until expiration over congressional objection
entries.note: ~$4B lapsed 2025-09-30 after SCOTUS emergency stay; GAO/CRS say the tactic violates the Impoundment Control Act but no merits ruling exists. Power of the purse over expiring funds now survives only at executive discretion. Reversal: merits ruling against unilateral impoundment or ICA amendment.

entries.title: Trump v. Slaughter: Humphrey's Executor overruled; for-cause removal protection for independent agency heads unconstitutional
entries.note: Reviewer set magnitude 4 (2026-07-28): the for-cause check is eliminated as controlling constitutional law; Trump v. Cook's Fed carve-out and Congress's indirect levers do not change that no statutory fix can reverse it. Reversal requires the Court itself or amendment.

entries.title: Schedule Policy/Career in effect: OPM final rule + EO 14410 reclassify career civil servants to at-will
entries.note: OPM rule effective 2026-03-09; EO 14410 (2026-06-03) executed first tranche (~8,000 positions, up to ~50,000 eligible). No injunction as of late July 2026 despite NTEU/AFGE suits. Reversal: vacatur, rescinding EO, or statutory codification.

entries.title: Mass IG removals stand despite being held unlawful; 30-day-notice protection left without effective remedy
entries.note: Reviewer set magnitude 3 (2026-07-28): D.D.C. held the removals unlawful but confirmed the notice requirement carries no reinstatement remedy, so IGs are de facto removable at will - the check survives only at executive discretion. Appeal/back-pay litigation pending; a remedy-bearing appellate ruling would lower this.

entries.title: Criminal contempt for executive defiance neutralized: D.C. Circuit mandamus ends Boasberg proceedings
entries.note: After the 2025-03-15 deportation flights defied a TRO, the one sustained contempt attempt was extinguished by 2-1 mandamus (2026-04-14, en banc denied). Contempt against the executive effectively unavailable in this circuit's current configuration. Reversal: en banc/SCOTUS repudiation or a successful future contempt prosecution.

entries.title: DOJ prosecutorial independence norm abandoned: directed dismissals/indictments; resisting career prosecutors removed
entries.note: Entrenched pattern: Adams dismissal directive + mass resignations (Feb 2025); Comey/James indictments over career objections via hand-picked interim US Attorney; national-security prosecutor firings. Courts imposed partial friction (Nov 2025 dismissals on appointment grounds; appeal pending) but the directed-prosecution practice itself is unchecked. Overlaps directed_prosecutions_opposition_figures (different domain/facet - see that note).

entries.title: Sustained intimidation environment for federal judges: impeachment-for-rulings campaigns, record threat levels
entries.note: Formal check (life tenure) intact - no judge removed; harm is to the norm environment. Mag 1 conservative. Raise if USMS protection is ever actually pulled in retaliation.

entries.title: Executive orders and DOJ campaign asserting federal control over state election administration (EO 14248, EO 14399, voter-roll demands)
entries.note: Merged entry (two research passes covered EO 14399 separately). EO 14248 enjoined for 19 states; EO 14399 enjoined in 23 states + DC but operative elsewhere with USPS implementing rule; ~23 states already handed over voter data (durable transfer). SCOTUS emergency application pending (filed 2026-07-27) - a grant before the midterms raises this to 3.

entries.title: NSPM-7: counterterrorism and financial-enforcement apparatus directed at 'radical left' domestic opposition
entries.note: Standing directive, actively operationalized (designations Nov-Dec 2025; 15-defendant indictment June 2026). Neutral application of terrorism/tax enforcement now discretionary. No injunction against the memorandum itself as of July 2026.

entries.title: DOJ prosecution of the president's named adversaries via hand-picked prosecutor (Comey, James)
entries.note: Opposition-rights facet of the DOJ-independence entry (judiciary domain) - kept separate because the harms land in different domains; magnitudes set so the pair is not double-counted at full weight. Judicial check held so far (Nov 2025 dismissals; 4th Cir. hearing Sept 2026). Revival there raises magnitude.

entries.title: White House seizure of press-pool composition; viewpoint-based exclusion of the AP
entries.note: WHCA pool control stripped Feb 2025; AP exclusion in effect after D.C. Cir. stayed the injunction (June 2025); merits undecided as of July 2026.

entries.title: Pentagon credential regime conditioning access on pre-publication restrictions; press corps expelled
entries.note: ~40-50 correspondents surrendered credentials Oct 2025. District court held revocation provisions unconstitutional (Mar 2026) but found DoD 'continues to flout' the order (Apr 2026); on-the-ground access still curtailed.

entries.title: FCC license threats and 'news distortion' investigations policing broadcaster content
entries.note: Kept at 2: no license actually revoked and no court has blessed the practice. Reversal: closing retaliatory proceedings or injunction against content-based license review.

entries.title: Standing visa-revocation and ideological social-media vetting targeting speech (Catch and Revoke)
entries.note: Standing policy through mid-2026; established date approximate. Scope of revocations government-reported and hard to verify independently.

entries.title: Loyalty-based purge of FBI leadership/agents and senior military officers as standing practice
entries.note: CJCS/CNO/JAG firings Feb 2025 through Army Chief of Staff ~Apr 2026 (21+ generals); FBI suits allege explicit loyalty vetting. Firings undisputed; allegations one-sided; no reinstatements as of July 2026.

entries.title: Long-term domestic Guard deployment for civilian policing (DC through 2029; Memphis, New Orleans), curtailed by Trump v. Illinois
entries.note: DC deployment extended through Inauguration Day 2029; Memphis/New Orleans continue with state consent. Over-state-objection track checked by Trump v. Illinois (Dec 2025) and withdrawals from Chicago/LA/Portland. Insurrection Act not invoked but not foreclosed.
